title: Training Language Models to Fail Gracefully
abstract: arXiv:2610.20401v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning makes language models better at solving tasks, but the same mechanism also rewards guessing. When success is the only way to earn reward, opting for a safe fallback is always worse than a long-shot attempt. When a wrong action can corrupt a database or ship broken code, that incentive can be costly. Therefore, we propose training models to fail gracefully: to preserve successful behavior whenever possible while learning to execute a safe fallback policy when acting would be unreliable. However, naively using policy gradients with intermediate reward for fallback behavior is brittle due to unfavorable optimization dynamics. We address this challenge with GracefulRL, which reshapes the optimization landscape to promote graceful failure. Importantly, this behavior emerges directly from outcome-level reward signals, without annotations specifying when to fall back or additional inference-time machinery such as a verifi

translated_title: 训练语言模型优雅地失败
translated_abstract: 强化学习能让语言模型更擅长解决任务，但同样的机制也会奖励猜测行为。当成功是获得奖励的唯一途径时，选择安全的回退方案总是不如孤注一掷的尝试划算。而当错误的操作可能破坏数据库或提交有缺陷的代码时，这种激励机制可能代价高昂。因此，我们提出训练模型“优雅地失败”：在尽可能保持成功行为的同时，学会在行动不可靠时执行安全的回退策略。然而，由于不利的优化动态，简单地在策略梯度中对回退行为使用中间奖励是脆弱的。我们通过GracefulRL来应对这一挑战，该方法通过重塑优化格局来促进优雅失败。重要的是，这种行为直接从结果层面的奖励信号中涌现，无需标注何时回退，也无需额外的推理时机制（如验证器）。
tldr: 提出GracefulRL方法，通过重塑优化格局，使语言模型仅凭结果级奖励信号就能学会在行动不可靠时执行安全的回退策略、实现“优雅失败”，无需人工标注或推理时额外机制。
en_tdlr: GracefulRL reshapes the optimization landscape to train language models to fail gracefully—preserving successful behavior while executing safe fallback policies when unreliable—emerging directly from outcome-level rewards without annotations or inference-time machinery.
